result.question: Which of Tesla, Apple, and Nvidia had the highest revenue in their most recent fiscal years, and what were the figures?
result.answer: Among Tesla, Apple, and Nvidia, Apple had the highest revenue in its most recent fiscal year. Apple reported net sales of $416,161,000,000 (approximately $416.2 billion) for FY 2025, the fiscal year ending September 27, 2025 [xbrl:0000320193-25-000079:us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax:2025-09-27]. Nvidia reported revenue of $215,938,000,000 (approximately $215.9 billion) for FY 2026, the fiscal year ending January 25, 2026 [xbrl:0001045810-26-000021:us-gaap:Revenues:2026-01-25]. Tesla reported revenues of $94,827,000,000 (approximately $94.8 billion) for FY 2025, the fiscal year ending December 31, 2025 [xbrl:0001628280-26-003952:us-gaap:Revenues:2025-12-31]. Apple's revenue of approximately $416.2 billion was the highest of the three companies.
